source: 575 “Handover”
target: 575 “Traditio”

source: After a while, Charname reached his limit.
target: Post aliquod tempus, Charname metam suam attigit.

source: He stared at Nolfi and questioned, “Do you have any secret collaborators?”
target: Nolfi intuens est et interrogavit: “Habesne collaboratores secretos?”

source: Nolfi gently nodded and admitted, “Yes.”
target: Nolfi leniter annuens dixitque: “Ita.”

source: Batna and Charname anticipated this response, but it failed to dampen Charname’s excitement.
target: Batna et Charname hanc responsionem praevidebant, sed ea excitamentum Charname non minuere potuit.

source: “Who is it?”
target: “Quis est?”

source: Nolfi hesitated for a moment before revealing, “It’s, it’s Juan Oro!”
target: Nolfi paulisper hesitavit antequam patefecit: “Iste, iste Juan Oro!”

source: Juan Oro?
target: Juan Oro?

source: The president of the Fisheries Guild?
target: Praeses Gildae Piscariorum?

source: Batna was caught off guard.
target: Batna repente stupefactus est.

source: Charname shared the sentiment.
target: Charname similem sententiam habuit.

source: Could the spy be the boss?
target: Num speculator dux sit?

source: Despite his critique, he pressed on, “Are you sure it’s Juan Oro?”
target: Quamquam eius critica non impedivit, pergebat: “Esne certus eum esse Juan Oro?”

source: While instructing Juan Oro to investigate the core members of the Fisheries Guild, Lumian, who had uncovered the Earth Mother Church’s true motives, sought similar information from Noelia of the Fertility Order, which included Juan Oro, the president.
target: Dum iuberet Juan Oro ad inquirendum membra principalia Gildae Piscariorum, Lumian, qui veras causas Ecclesiae Matris Terrae detexit, quaesivit similia a Noelia Ordinis Fertilitatis, cuius praeses erat Juan Oro.

source: Official reports indicated that Juan Oro’s health had been relatively stable.
target: Relationes officiales indicabant salutem Juan Oro relative stabile fuisse.

source: He had never faced serious illness or severe injury.
target: Numquam morbum grave aut vulnera gravia passi est.

source: Moreover, he hadn’t displayed any signs of losing control of his lizard form.
target: Praeterea, nullas ostendit signa imperii formae lacertae suae amittendi.

source: In essence, there was no indication that he had been possessed by Ultraman, a transmigrator.
target: In summa, nihil indicium erat eum ab Ultramano, transmigratore, invasum esse.

source: Naturally, a definitive judgment couldn’t be made based solely on this information.
target: Naturaliter, iudicium definitum ex his tantum rebus fieri poterat.

source: After all, when the original bodies of many Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society members met unfortunate fates, there were no witnesses.
target: Postremo, cum corpora originalia multorum membrorum Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Crispatorum casus infelices adepti essent, nulli testes fuerunt.

source: Despite growing older, Juan Oro’s personality remained relatively unchanged, sans the increasingly stubborn streak and a penchant for returning to the sea.
target: Quamquam senescens, indoles Juan Oro relative immota remansit, excepto increbrescenti pertinacitate et cupiditate redeundi ad mare.

source: Crucially, if Juan Oro were Ultraman, many of April Fool’s disruptive actions during the sea prayer ritual would be unnecessary.
target: Praecipue, si Juan Oro Ultraman esset, multae actiones perturbantes Stultorum Aprilis in ritu precationis maris supervacua essent.

source: It could be executed in a simpler and more covert manner.
target: Id fieri potuit modo simpliciore et magis occulto.

source: Considering these factors, Charname had previously concluded that Juan Oro wasn’t a key member of April Fool’s.
target: His rebus consideratis, Charname antea conclusit Juan Oro non esse membrum principale Stultorum Aprilis.

source: Nolfi pursed her lips and disclosed, “It’s him. I met him six months ago in Port Rayak.”
target: Nolfi labra contraxit et declaravit: “Iste est. Eum sex menses abhinc in Portu Rayak conveni.”

source: Rayak, located north of the Dariège mountain range, served as a port under the jurisdiction of the Riston Province in the Intis Republic.
target: Rayak, qui ad septentrionem catenae montium Dariège situm est, functus est ut portus sub iurisdictione Provinciae Riston in Re Publica Intis.

source: “Met before?” Charname blurted out.
target: “Prius convenisti?” exclamavit Charname.

source: “Your eyes can deceive you. What you perceive doesn’t necessarily reflect reality.”
target: “Oculi tui fallere possunt. Quod percipis, non necessario veritatem repraesentat.”

source: Unable to hold back his desire to confide, he continued, “Just like now. The me you see isn’t equivalent to the real me. The difference is quite significant.”
target: Non potendo retinere desiderium confidenti, pergebat: “Sicut nunc. Non idem ego, quem vides, sed verus ego sum. Disparitas valde magna est.”

source: “Are you suggesting that the Juan Oro I encountered was an imposter?” Nolfi expressed disbelief.
target: “Num putas Juan Oro quem conveni impostorem esse?” Nolfi incredulitate expressit.

source: “But, he also demonstrated the ability to control the waves!”
target: “Sed etiam potestatem fluctus regendi demonstravit!”

source: Charname chuckled.
target: Charname subridit.

source: “Many Fisheries Guild committee members possess such abilities. What if one of them impersonated Juan Oro?”
target: “Multi membri consilii Gildae Piscariorum tales facultates habent. Quid si quis eorum Juan Oro fingat?”

source: “But, but it’s too similar…” Nolfi fell into self-doubt.
target: “Sed, sed nimis simile est…” Nolfi in dubitationem incidit.

source: Charname spoke casually, “Based on the intel we gathered, Juan Oro hasn’t left Port Santa for nearly a decade.
target: Charname levius locutus est: “Ex notitia quam collegimus, Juan Oro paene decennium a Porto Santa non discessit.

source: “He’s the president of the Fisheries Guild.
target: Praeses est Gildae Piscariorum.

source: He frequents the association daily.”
target: Cotidie consociationem frequentat.

source: While this information was used to persuade Nolfi, it wasn’t conclusive evidence.
target: Haec notitia ad Nolfi persuadendum adhibita est, sed non erat probatio definitiva.

source: If Juan Oro were Ultraman, he could have enlisted Mad Lady’s help to travel to Port Rayak and return in less than two hours.
target: Si Juan Oro Ultraman esset, auxilium “Mad Lady” petuisset ut Portum Rayak iter faceret et intra duas horas rediret.

source: Under such circumstances, hardly anyone would notice his brief absence.
target: Sub talibus condicionibus, vix quis absentiam eius brevem animadvertiret.

source: Nolfi fell silent, pondering, and muttered, “Then, then who could it be?”
target: Nolfi tacuit, meditans, et submurmuravit: “Ergo, quis igitur id esse potest?”

source: “How would I know?” Charname expressed his criticism.
target: “Quomodo id sciam?” inquit Charname.

source: Appearing slightly awkward, he shifted the conversation.
target: Parum incommodus apparens, conversationem mutavit.

source: “What kind of collaboration did the imposter Juan Oro seek with you? Do you have any means to obliterate the underwater palace and put an end to the sea prayer ritual once and for all?”
target: “Quam cooperationem imposter Juan Oro tecum petiit? Habesne viam ad palatium subaquaticum delendum atque ritum precationis maris semel atque in perpetuum finendum?”

source: Nolfi’s body quivered, as if grappling with an innate urge.
target: Corpus Nolfi tremuit, quasi cum innato impetu certaret.

source: After a brief pause, she struggled in response, “H-he’ll help me cover my tracks and disregard my existence. He’ll permit me to board a ship and infiltrate the sea sacrifice waters ahead of the Governor of the Sea’s vessel and conceal myself.
target: Post brevem moram, laborans respondit: “Ille me adiuvabit vestigia mea celare atque existentiam meam neglegere. Permisit mihi navem conscendere et in aquas sacrificii maris, ante vecturam Gubernatoris Maris, introire atque me celare.

source: “Then, as the Governor of the Sea unveils the Ring of the Sea Queen and utters the words of the marriage proposal, I’ll deliver a line.
target: Tum, cum Gubernator Maris anulum Reginae Maris detegit et verba pro nuptiis pronuntiat, ego rem dicam.

source: “My mother imparted that passage to me. It originated from her profound connection with the palace when she received the sea’s blessing. Its—its purpose is to trigger a self-destruct sequence within the palace.”
target: “Mater mea hanc locutionem mihi tradidit. Ea orta est ex profunda coniunctione cum palatio, cum benedictionem maris accepisset. Propositum eius est ordinem auto-destructionis intra palatium excitare.”

source: Nolfi’s words flowed more effortlessly, signifying that she had given up on resisting.
target: Verba Nolfi leviter fluere coeperunt, significantes eam resistendi conatum deseruisse.

source: “Self-destruction sequence? Are you certain? Do you comprehend that language from God knows where?” Charname wore an expression of skepticism.
target: “Ordo auto-destructionis? Esne certus? Quidam intellegisne hanc linguam ex ignoto?” Charname vultum scepticismi gerebat.

source: “That’s what my mother told me.” Nolfi conveyed her lack of understanding of the language’s meaning.
target: “Id est quod mater mea mihi dixerat.” Nolfi significavit se linguam significationis non intellegere.

source: Charname pressed on, “Does your mother comprehend that language?”
target: Charname pergebat: “Intellegitne mater tua hanc linguam?”

source: “She doesn’t, but she grasps its significance. Can you fathom it? It’s a form of spiritual communication,” Nolfi defended her mother with determination.
target: “Ea non intellegit, sed significationem eius percipit. Potesne id capere? Est genus communicationis spiritualis,” Nolfi matrem suam defendit.

source: “Deceiving through soul-level communication isn’t out of the realm of possibility. Moreover, it’s always simpler to dupe the illiterate,” Charname muttered his internal grievances once again.
target: “Decipere per communicationem animorum non est impossibile. Praeterea, semper facilius est ignorantes decipere,” Charname iterum murmurat.

source: He furrowed his brow and inquired, “Did the imposter Juan Oro inform you that the sea prayer ritual failed last year?”
target: Frons contraxit et interrogavit: “Num imposter Juan Oro tibi nuntiavit ritum precationis maris anno praeterito defecisse?”

source: “No. If he had, I wouldn’t have chartered a boat at Port Santa,” Nolfi expressed her frustration on the matter.
target: “Minime. Si id fuisset, navem ad Portum Santa non emi,” Nolfi irata dixit.

source: Had she known from the beginning that last year’s sea prayer ritual had faltered, she would have anticipated heightened vigilance at Port Santa this year.
target: Si ab initio scivisset ritum precationis maris anni praeteriti defecisse, praecognoverat vigilantiam auctam in Porto Santa hoc anno.

source: Those attempting to rent a boat for a sea journey would undoubtedly be on a watch list.
target: Qui navem ad iter maris conducere conantur, indubitanter in indice vigilium erunt.

source: Charname wore a perplexed expression.
target: Charname vultum perplexum gerebat.

source: “Wouldn’t that mean the imposter Juan Oro was expecting you to be apprehended by Lato Guiaro…”
target: “Nonne hoc significat imposter Juan Oro te a Lato Guiaro capi expectare...”

source: Half a year ago, neither April Fool’s nor anyone with ulterior motives in Port Santa had foreseen Lumian’s arrival to investigate the sea prayer ritual.
target: Ante sex menses, nec Stultorum Aprilis nec quisquam ulterioris propositi in Porto Santa adventum Lumiani ad ritum precationis maris explorandum praevidit.

source: This suggested that Nolfi’s original role wasn’t designed to lure Lumian.
target: Hoc indicabat munus originale Nolfi non esse destinatum ad Lumian alliciendum.

source: It might have been part of April Fool’s initial plan until they reconsidered, opting to exploit the great adventurer’s investigations.
target: Fortasse pars fuit consilii initialis Stultorum Aprilis, donec reconsideraverunt, optantes investigationes magni adventarii explere.

source: Under such circumstances, letting Nolfi be captured by Lato Guiaro was evidently not a mere oversight in April Fool’s plan, unless that was their intention all along.
target: Sub talibus condicionibus, sinere Nolfi a Lato Guiaro capi, manifeste non fuerat simplex error in consilio Stultorum Aprilis, nisi id semper propositum eorum fuisset.

source: Is Nolfi being thrown into the mix to confuse the Fisheries Guild and sow suspicion among other committee members against Juan Oro?
target: Num Nolfi in mixturam iacitur ut Gildam Piscariorum confundat et suspicionem inter reliquos membros consilii adversus Juan Oro serat?

source: A rift between them would hinder their cooperation.
target: Divortium inter eos cooperationem impediat.

source: But this strategy doesn’t seem cunning enough…
target: Sed haec ratio non videtur satis callida esse…

source: Is it an attempt to divert the Earth Mother Church’s attention from this year’s sea prayer ritual and redirect it towards Nolfi?
target: Num conatur Ecclesiam Matris Terrae ab hoc anno ritu precationis maris avertere et ad Nolfi convertere?

source: Or… or…
target: Vel… vel…

source: Franca, posing as Charname, had a guess.
target: Franca, simulans Charname, coniecturam habuit.

source: Or perhaps, Lato Guiaro is a member of April Fool’s!
target: Vel fortasse Lato Guiaro membrum Stultorum Aprilis est!

source: The moment Nolfi arrived at Port Santa and tried to rent a boat, she was apprehended.
target: Nolfi, cum ad Portum Santa pervenisset et navem conducere conata esset, capta est.

source: Not only does Lato Guiaro hold complete sway over this “collaborator,” but he also offers corresponding protection…
target: Non solum Lato Guiaro hunc “collaboratorem” plene administrat, sed etiam idoneam protectionem praebet…

source: Could it be that when the sea prayer ritual is on the brink of commencing, he will feign a lapse in vigilance, allowing Nolfi to escape successfully and secure a boat?
target: Num fieri potest ut, cum ritus precationis maris initium capere prope sit, ille vigilantiae lapsum simul fingeat, quo Nolfi feliciter effugeret et navem assequeretur?

source: With this speculation in mind, the more Franca considered Lato Guiaro, the more something felt awry.
target: Hac speculatione innixa, quanto magis Franca Lato Guiaro considerabat, tanto magis aliquid male se habere videbatur.

source: Whether it was the intel provided by the Knight of Swords or information from the authorities, a consistent message emerged:
target: Sive notitia a Milite Gladii sive ex auctoritatibus recepta, constans nuntius emersit:

source: Lato Guiaro had slept in separate rooms from his wife many years ago!
target: Lato Guiaro in cellis separatis a uxore sua multos annos abhinc dormiverat!

source: For transmigrators, after taking over the original owner’s body, their greatest apprehension was being exposed by those around them through various details.
target: Nam transmigratoribus, postquam corpus originalis possederunt, maxima eorum sollicitudo erat, ne ab iis circumstantibus variis indicibus detegerentur.

source: Among these people, the ones most likely to unveil their disguises were their deeply connected parents and spouses who shared the same bed.
target: Inter eos, qui larvas suas revelare poterant, erant parentes et coniugi, qui intime conexi erant et eundem lectum communicabant.

source: In particular, the latter were privy to many interaction habits unknown to others.
target: Praesertim illi novebant plurimas mores interactionis, quae aliis ignotae erant.

source: In such circumstances, opting to sleep in separate rooms was evidently a form of self-protection for transmigrators.
target: In talibus condicionibus, eligere dormire in cellis separatis, manifeste, forma pro sua tutela erat transmigratoribus.

source: Initially, Franca had a fleeting suspicion when she came across this information, but she promptly dismissed it.
target: Initio, Franca suspicionem efhemeram habuit cum has notitias occurrisset, sed eam celeriter abjecit.

source: Firstly, it wasn’t uncommon for a middle-aged man and his wife to have separate sleeping quarters.
target: Primum, non erat insolitum virum medii aetatis et uxorem eius cellas dormitorias separatas habere.

source: Lato Guiaro wasn’t the sole Fisheries Guild committee member to adopt this practice.
target: Lato Guiaro non solus membrum consilii Gildae Piscariorum fuit qui hanc praxim suscepit.

source: Secondly, Lato Guiaro had previously been forcibly controlled by the Knight of Swords and Lumian before being subjected to truth serum.
target: Secundo, Lato Guiaro antea a Milite Gladii et Lumiano vi coercitus fuit, antequam potione veritatis subiectus esset.

source: During subsequent questioning, he displayed no indications of ties to April Fool’s.
target: Subsequentibus quaestionibus, nullas indicationes nexuum ad Stultorum Aprilis ostendit.

source: He didn’t even betray any signs of stifling laughter when discussing marrying the sea!
target: Neque quidem ostendit ullas notas risus cohibendi, cum de nuptiis cum mari loqueretur!

source: However, what if Lato Guiaro, who willingly transmitted Nolfi’s information, had prepped in advance to elude the adventurer’s detection and had cloaked a portion of his memories through Hypnosis?
target: Attamen, quid si Lato Guiaro, qui libenter notitias Nolfi transmisit, antea se praeparaverit ut detectionem adventarii eluderet et partem memoriarum suarum per hypnosin celasset?

source: The truth serum fundamentally heightened the inclination to share with others.
target: Serum veritatis fundamentice auxit inclinationem ad communicandum cum aliis.

source: Anything beyond the user’s knowledge or comprehension remained veiled.
target: Quidquid extra scientiam aut comprehensionem usoris erat, velatum manebat.

source: The pressing question now was: where did Lato Guiaro acquire Beyonders or items with similar capabilities through April Fool’s channels?
target: Quaestio premens erat nunc: ubi Lato Guiaro Beyonders vel similia instrumenta per canales Stultorum Aprilis obtinuit?

source: Franca, increasingly convinced that Lato Guiaro was Ultraman, recalled a crucial detail: the current Governor of the Sea, Simon, belonged to the Guiaro family!
target: Franca, magis persuasus Lato Guiaro Ultraman esse, recordatus est rei maximi momenti: gubernator maris praesentis, Simon, familiae Guiaro pertinere!

source: Previously, Juan Oro had heeded her advice to conduct a blood test on everyone, excluding Lumian, who boarded the ship.
target: Praecedens, Juan Oro consilium eius audivit ut in omnibus sanguinis examina facerentur, excepto Lumiano, qui navem conscendit.

source: The aim was to confirm familial ties and unveil any outsiders attempting to infiltrate in disguise.
target: Propositum erat nexūs familiares confirmare et externos detegere, qui sub specie dissimulandi infiltrandi conabantur.

source: What if Simon Guiaro was Lato Guiaro in disguise?
target: Quid si Simon Guiaro Lato Guiaro sub specie dissimulata esset?

source: This method would only affirm his identity!
target: Hic modus solum identitatem eius affirmaret!

source: On the betrothal ship, now resting on the seabed as if weighed down by a colossal boulder,
target: In nave sponsali, nunc in fundo maris, quasi ingenti saxo onerata,

source: Simon Guiaro, positioned at the bow, appeared bewildered, his face a mixture of panic and confusion.
target: Simon Guiaro, in prora positus, attonitus apparuit, facies eius ex pavoris et confusionis mixta.

source: Yet, a faint curl formed at the corners of his mouth.
target: Attamen, in angulis oris eius levis curvatura orta est.

source: At that moment, the Governor of the Sea handover ritual from the previous night flashed in his mind.
target: In illo momento, ritu traditionis Gubernatoris Maris ex vespera in mente eius fulsit.

source: Clad in a pristine blue suit, Simon Guiaro entered the hall, noting his predecessor, Governor of the Sea Miguel, clad in a retro white robe, observing him.
target: Indutus veste caerulea nitida, Simon Guiaro in aulam intravit, animadvertens praecessori suo, Gubernatori Maris Miguel, in toga alba antiquata induto, qui eum observabat.

source: Following the predetermined procedure, he uttered the prearranged words.
target: Secundum praeordinatum ordinem, verba praeconata edixit.

source: “I’ll leave the sea to you.”
target: “Mare tibi relinquam.”

source: “It’s my honor,” Simon Guiaro responded solemnly as he advanced toward the other party.
target: “Honor mihi est,” Simon Guiaro sollemniter respondit, dum ad alteram partem progressus est.

source: Miguel extended his right hand, and Simon Guiaro reached out for a handshake.
target: Miguel dextram manum protulit, et Simon Guiaro manum porrigens, eam premere coepit.

source: This gesture symbolized the departure of the former Governor of the Sea and the commencement of Simon Guiaro’s role as the present Governor of the Sea.
target: Hoc gestu discessum pristini Gubernatoris Maris et initium muneris Simon Guiaro ut Gubernatoris Maris praesentis significabant.

source: After the handshake, they passed each other by.
target: Post concussum manus, invicem praeterierunt.

source: As they turned their gazes in opposite directions, the corners of their lips subtly curled upwards.
target: Cum oculos in contrarias partes verterent, anguli labiorum leviter sursum convoluti sunt.

source: Under the scrutiny of the numerous statues surrounding them, one advanced while the other exited the hall.
target: Sub vigili statueorum multitudine, unus progreditur, dum alter ex aula exit.
